mapper.sql: id, publication_id, tenant_company_id, user_id, agent_instance_id, install_source, status, installed_at, uninstalled_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mp_install (publication_id, tenant_company_id, user_id, agent_instance_id, install_source, status, installed_at, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{publicationId}, #{tenantCompanyId}, #{userId}, #{agentInstanceId}, COALESCE(#{installSource}, 'MARKET'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{installedAt}, NOW(3)), #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mp_install WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM mp_install WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY installed_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM mp_install WHERE tenant_company_id = #{tenantCompanyId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY installed_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE mp_install
status = #{status}, uninstalled_at = #{uninstalledAt}, update_time = NOW(3)
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
